# What does federal excise tax really cost your brewery per keg and per case?

> Free federal beer excise tax calculator for craft brewers: enter kegs, cases and barrels and see the CBMA $3.50 and $16 per barrel tax, the cost per keg and case, and what growing past 60,000 barrels does. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
